s1.syndrome_frame: A long-standing, soft tissue mass on the flank with a stable size and appearance, causing concern for appearance and fullness
salient_findings: Soft tissue mass on the right flank
Overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia
key_facts: The patient is an adolescent girl
The condition has been present since infancy
The mass is located on the right flank
The mass is soft and exophytic
The mass has overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia
The initial measurements were 0.8 cm high and 7.5 cm wide
The mass is composed of mature adipose and fibrous tissues
The patient was concerned about appearance and fullness caused by the lesion

shortlist.label: Fibrous hamartoma of infancy
shortlist.why_kept: matches the description of a long-standing, soft tissue mass present since infancy

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: common benign tumor composed of mature adipose tissue, consistent with histological findings

shortlist.label: Fibrolipoma
shortlist.why_kept: benign tumor composed of both fibrous and adipose tissues, matching the lesion's composition

shortlist.label: Angiolipoma
shortlist.why_kept: benign tumor with vascular components, consistent with overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia

shortlist.label: Spindle cell lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: benign tumor with a mix of adipose and fibrous components, plausible given the lesion's appearance and histology

raw.rationale: The condition has been present since infancy, is soft and exophytic, and composed of mature adipose and fibrous tissues, which are characteristic features of fibrous hamartoma of infancy

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: Lipomas are typically composed only of adipose tissue, whereas this lesion contains both adipose and fibrous tissues

rejected.label: Fibrolipoma
rejected.why: While fibrolipoma contains both fibrous and adipose tissue, the presence of the lesion since infancy and its specific characteristics better fit fibrous hamartoma of infancy

rejected.label: Angiolipoma
rejected.why: Angiolipomas are typically painful and have a higher vascular component, which is not the primary characteristic described in this case

rejected.label: Spindle cell lipoma
rejected.why: Spindle cell lipomas are rare and typically occur in older adults, not in infants or adolescents
